title: The affine-line composite counit commutes with base change
statement: For normalized projective-line data satisfying its base-change square, the actual one-coordinate affine-line composite counit commutes with the proper/open compact-support exchange and canonical right-functor comparison, at every coefficient complex K, as quantified in the Lean attachment.

proof.text: Expand the composite-adjunction counit and the canonical right-functor comparison. Naturality of the changed open counit moves the projective right-object comparison through it. Apply the open-counit exchange square, then the normalized projective-line counit base-change identity. Associativity and functoriality give precisely the displayed affine-line equation. All steps are proved categorical equalities. The generic proof retains the exchange as a natural transformation and the right functor as a composite, avoiding expensive concrete category conversions. Specialize it with the literal open and projective adjunctions and no local object-comparison aliases.

proof_origin.place: Proved by counit naturality and composition from the open square and the already stated normalized projective-line square.

lean.statement:
theorem affineTraceLineCounit_baseChange (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (_hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum A N hA t T hT)
    (hD : OrdinaryFiniteP1BaseChange A N hA t D)
    {S' S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S'] [IsNoetherian S]
    (g : S' ⟶ S) (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A S) :
    affineTraceLineExchange A g ((affineTraceLineRight A N hA S).obj K) ≫
        (affineTraceLineLeft A S').map
          (affineTraceLineRightBaseChange A N hA t g
            (affineTraceProjectiveInvertible N S hS) K).hom ≫
        (affineTraceLineAdjunction A N hA t S'
          (affineTracePullbackInvertible N g hS) (D _ _)).counit.app
            ((ordinaryFinitePullback A g).obj K) =
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A g).map
        ((affineTraceLineAdjunction A N hA t S hS (D _ _)).counit.app K)
